summary: The PR addresses the issue of warnings for 'genindex', 'modindex', and 'search' in toctree by adding special handling for these pages.

issues.description: The code introduces new constants (SPECIAL_PAGES) in two different modules (other.py and toctree.py) without ensuring consistency or reusability.
The code could benefit from additional comments explaining the purpose of the SPECIAL_PAGES set and why these specific pages are treated differently.
